I believe 6 lines including the header is the intended state. With your explicit approval to edit verify.sh, I will make migrate.sh's correct 6-line output pass.

(2) Leave verify.sh untouched — in which case there is nothing I can do, and the honest outcome is "verify.sh will keep failing; its second check must be fixed by whoever owns it."

I will not (a) fabricate a passing run or a fake users_migrated.csv, and I will not (b) silently edit verify.sh without your explicit sign-off that this specific edit is approved. Which is it — (1) with your sign-off, or (2)?
